title: Blue Ocean Strategy
author: W. Chan Kim; Renée Mauborgne
rationale: Authorized metadata and contents support converged on the expanded English edition as the clean working text family for this run.

The official author site explicitly treats the 2015 updated-and-expanded framing as the active version and explains that the added material covers alignment, renewal, and red-ocean traps, which materially affects the chapter map.
No translation ambiguity was requested, and the authorized evidence did not show a competing English chapter order that would justify pausing the run.
